name: Kuninaka Kaori
source:
As a third-year at Shiromiya Academy, Kaori leads the Esquire knight order. Not only has she already achieved her knight qualifications during her studies, but she was also part of a formal knight order before the arrival of the new students. Her talents are extraordinary; she's a natural genius with superior physical abilities, effortlessly excelling at anything new. This versatility, however, leaves her without any specific hobbies to pursue.

Kaori's approach to leadership in Esquire is to provide thoughtful guidance from behind the scenes, helping to unite and shape the less experienced members.

She's always the epitome of calm and gentleness, frequently seen with a soft smile. While Kaori is a model of dependability in her school and professional life, she's known for being somewhat lax in her private life. She is particularly not good in the mornings; usually groggy upon waking, often engaging in problematic behavior such as sleepwalking around the dorm naked.

Kaori doesn't have any specific hobbies but loves her naps. She's not a fan of bugs, though.

"Remember, once you wear that armor, you're representing Esquire. Tackle your roles with focus and dedication."

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/koikishi/chara.html/]the official site[/url].]
